Name: ASSET_GEOMETORY_PARAM_ST
Description: Per-model asset (AEG) settings. The row ID is the asset model number (AEG001_234 → 1234). Read by every placed or spawned asset of that model: behaviour type, destruction, pickup, burning, sounds, effects, navmesh and ray tracing.

Fields.Name: Sound Bank ID
Fields.Description: Sound bank the asset loads (sound\aeg###_###.bnk). -1: no bank.

Fields.Name: Break Sound ID
Fields.Description: Sound played when the asset breaks. -1: the asset model number × 1000 is used.

Fields.Name: Draw Param Reference ID
Fields.Description: PartsDrawParam row used to draw the asset. -1: the default draw settings.

Fields.Name: Hit Create Type
Fields.Description: How collision is built for the asset. Passed to the collision setup; only applies to static assets. Retail: 1 for most rows, 0 and 2 also used.

Fields.Name: Asset Behavior Type
Fields.Description: Dynamic: full asset (breakable, pickup, burning, physics). Static: light asset with limited features; it can't break and isn't runtime-created. Partial Static: partly static. Most features check this first.

Fields.Name: Collision Detection Type
Fields.Description: Selects the collision filter set. 0: default (depends on Behavior Type). 11–16: special filter sets (13 is the most common in retail). 1–10 aren't handled. A non-zero collision type set on the MSB part overrides this.

Fields.Name: Rain Blocking Type
Fields.Description: How the asset blocks rain (rain effects and the wet look underneath). Read when the asset is set up and by cutscene actors.

Fields.Name: HP
Fields.Description: Damage needed to break the asset. -1: indestructible. Only dynamic assets with HP ≥ 0 are breakable; the collision-break flags also need this. Assets with Is Destroyed on Pickup get 0.

Fields.Name: Defence
Fields.Description: An attack breaks or damages the asset only if its object attack power is above this value.

Fields.Name: Destruction Stop Time
Fields.Description: Seconds after breaking before the debris physics is forcibly stopped. 0: never forced.

Fields.Name: Break SFX ID
Fields.Description: Effect played when the asset breaks. -1: the default effect 810030.

Fields.Name: Break SFX Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly where the break effect plays; it plays at every dummy poly with this ID. -1: at the asset's position.

Fields.Name: Break Landing SFX Column
Fields.Description: Column (0–31) of AssetMaterialSfxParam used when the broken asset first lands: the row is the material it lands on. -1: no landing effect. Not used in retail.

Fields.Name: Break Bullet Behavior ID
Fields.Description: BehaviorParam row for the bullet fired when the asset breaks, if Break Bullet Damage Condition allows it. -1: none. 9-digit IDs: the tens digit is replaced by the current NG+ cycle (0–7).

Fields.Name: Break Bullet Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the break bullet fires from. -1: the asset's position.

Fields.Name: Debris Fade Delay
Fields.Description: Seconds after breaking before the debris starts to fade out.

Fields.Name: Debris Fade Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the debris takes to fade out.

Fields.Name: Break AI Sound ID
Fields.Description: AiSoundParam row emitted when the asset breaks, so enemies can hear it. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Break Item Lot Type
Fields.Description: How Break Item Lot Param ID is awarded: 0 and 1 use two different award routines. The difference isn't established. Retail: 1 on 8 rows.

Fields.Name: Animated Break Count
Fields.Description: With Is Animated Destruction: the number of extra break animations the asset has. Retail uses 0 or 1.

Fields.Name: Break Bullet Damage Condition
Fields.Description: When the break bullet fires. 0: never. 1: on any break. 2–5: only if the last hit was of one specific attack type (internal codes 11, 12, 10 and 13).

Fields.Name: Is Destroyed on Player Collision
Fields.Description: Breaks when the player touches it. Only for breakable dynamic assets.

Fields.Name: Is Destroyed on Enemy Collision
Fields.Description: Breaks when an enemy touches it. Only for breakable dynamic assets.

Fields.Name: Is Destroyed by Riding
Fields.Description: Breaks when a character stands on it.

Fields.Name: Unbreakable on First Appearance
Fields.Description: The asset can't be broken when it first appears.

Fields.Name: Is Animated Destruction
Fields.Description: Breaks by playing a break animation instead of physics destruction. See Animated Break Count.

Fields.Name: Blocks Attacks
Fields.Description: Blocks attacks: attacks that hit this asset don't pass through to targets behind it.

Fields.Name: Attacks Recoil
Fields.Description: Melee attacks that hit the asset recoil off it. Retail: on for most assets.

Fields.Name: Is No Ray Tracing
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Is Ladder
Fields.Description: The asset is a ladder: it's registered in the map block's ladder list.

Fields.Name: Is Moving Object
Fields.Description: Marks a moving object, used for movement handling in multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Is Celestial Sphere
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it on 112 sky dome models.

Fields.Name: Is Paused during Cutscene
Fields.Description: The asset's animation pauses while a cutscene plays.

Fields.Name: Is Flammable
Fields.Description: The asset can burn. See the Burn fields. Retail: one test row.

Fields.Name: Can Be Repicked
Fields.Description: The asset can be picked again after respawning: the Repick fields are used instead of the Pickup fields.

Fields.Name: Is Destroyed on Pickup
Fields.Description: Picking the asset up breaks it instead of playing the picked-up animation.

Fields.Name: Is Destroyed by Giant Collision
Fields.Description: Breaks when a giant enemy touches it.

Fields.Name: Pre-destruction Navmesh Flag
Fields.Description: Navmesh flag the asset gives before it breaks. Read by the navmesh system at runtime.

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Interval
Fields.Description: Interval between fire-spreading bullets while burning (likely frames).

Fields.Name: Camera Distance to Update Cloth
Fields.Description: Cloth simulation only runs within this camera distance (m). 0: always runs.

Fields.Name: Runtime-Created Lifetime
Fields.Description: Seconds a runtime-created asset (spawned by a bullet, effect or event) stays before it's removed. 0: stays. Not used by static assets.

Fields.Name: Contact SE ID
Fields.Description: Sound played when the local player touches the asset. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Repick Anim ID Offset
Fields.Description: On repick, the uncollected and collected animations are offset by this value (collected = offset + 1).

Fields.Name: Wind Effect Rate - Before Destruction
Fields.Description: Wind strength multiplier before the asset breaks.

Fields.Name: Wind Effect Rate - After Destruction
Fields.Description: Wind strength multiplier after the asset breaks.

Fields.Name: Wind Effect Type - Before Destruction
Fields.Description: How wind affects the asset before it breaks.

Fields.Name: Wind Effect Type - After Destruction
Fields.Description: How wind affects the asset after it breaks.

Fields.Name: Override Material ID
Fields.Description: Replaces the model's hit material (hit effects, sounds, footsteps). -1: use the model's material. Ladders take their material only from this field.

Fields.Name: Automatic Generation Height Offset
Fields.Description: When the asset is created automatically, height (m) above the ground point where it's placed. A positive height from the creating row overrides it.

Fields.Name: Burn Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the asset burns. 0: burns indefinitely.

Fields.Name: Burn Break Threshold
Fields.Description: Burn progress (0–1) at which the burning asset breaks.

Fields.Name: Burn SFX ID [0]
Fields.Description: Effect 0 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn SFX ID [1]
Fields.Description: Effect 1 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn SFX ID [2]
Fields.Description: Effect 2 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn SFX ID [3]
Fields.Description: Effect 3 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn SFX Minimum Delay Time [0]
Fields.Description: Burn effect 0 starts after a random delay between this minimum and the maximum (seconds).

Fields.Name: Burn SFX Minimum Delay Time [1]
Fields.Description: Burn effect 1 starts after a random delay between this minimum and the maximum (seconds).

Fields.Name: Burn SFX Minimum Delay Time [2]
Fields.Description: Burn effect 2 starts after a random delay between this minimum and the maximum (seconds).

Fields.Name: Burn SFX Minimum Delay Time [3]
Fields.Description: Burn effect 3 starts after a random delay between this minimum and the maximum (seconds).

Fields.Name: Burn SFX Maximum Delay Time [0]
Fields.Description: Maximum delay (seconds) before burn effect 0 starts.

Fields.Name: Burn SFX Maximum Delay Time [1]
Fields.Description: Maximum delay (seconds) before burn effect 1 starts.

Fields.Name: Burn SFX Maximum Delay Time [2]
Fields.Description: Maximum delay (seconds) before burn effect 2 starts.

Fields.Name: Burn SFX Maximum Delay Time [3]
Fields.Description: Maximum delay (seconds) before burn effect 3 starts.

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Behavior ID [0]
Fields.Description: BehaviorParam row of fire-spreading bullet 0 while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Behavior ID [1]
Fields.Description: BehaviorParam row of fire-spreading bullet 1 while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Behavior ID [2]
Fields.Description: BehaviorParam row of fire-spreading bullet 2 while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Behavior ID [3]
Fields.Description: BehaviorParam row of fire-spreading bullet 3 while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Delay Time
Fields.Description: Seconds of burning before the fire-spreading bullets start.

Fields.Name: Paint Decal Target Texture Size
Fields.Description: Texture size for paint decals (such as blood) on the asset. 0: no paint decals. Powers of 2 up to 4096. Passed to the model setup.

Fields.Name: Post-destruction Navmesh Flag
Fields.Description: Navmesh flag the asset gives after it breaks.

Fields.Name: Near Camera Behavior Type
Fields.Description: How the asset is drawn when the camera gets close. Read when the asset's model is set up.

Fields.Name: Destroyed Item Lot Param ID
Fields.Description: ItemLotParam_map row awarded when the asset breaks. -1: none. A lot set on the MSB part overrides it.

Fields.Name: Pickup Action Button Param ID
Fields.Description: ActionButtonParam row for picking the asset up. -1: no pickup (unless the replacement pickup is set).

Fields.Name: Pickup Item Lot Param ID
Fields.Description: ItemLotParam_map row awarded on pickup. -1: no pickup. A pickup lot set on the MSB part overrides it.

Fields.Name: Auto Draw Group: Backface Check
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (likely used when building draw groups).

Fields.Name: Auto Draw Group: Depth Write
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (likely used when building draw groups).

Fields.Name: Auto Draw Group: Shadow Test
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (likely used when building draw groups).

Fields.Name: Is Height Check Enabled
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (a map tool check of the asset's ground height).

Fields.Name: Exclude from Subfloor Navmesh if below Hit
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (navmesh build setting).

Fields.Name: Block Navmesh Combine
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (navmesh build setting).

Fields.Name: Navmesh Flag Apply Type
Fields.Description: Where the asset's navmesh flag (before breaking) is applied. Read by the navmesh system at runtime.

Fields.Name: Navmesh Flag Apply Type - Destroyed
Fields.Description: Where the asset's navmesh flag (after breaking) is applied.

Fields.Name: Auto Draw Group: Pass Pixel Number
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (likely used when building draw groups).

Fields.Name: Pickup Replacement - Event Flag
Fields.Description: When this event flag is on, the Pickup Replacement fields are used instead. 0 or -1: never.

Fields.Name: Pickup Replacement - Anim ID Offset
Fields.Description: With the replacement flag on, the uncollected and collected animations are offset by this value (collected = offset + 1).

Fields.Name: Pickup Replacement - Action Button Param ID
Fields.Description: ActionButtonParam row used for pickup while the replacement flag is on.

Fields.Name: Pickup Replacement - Item Lot Param ID
Fields.Description: ItemLotParam_map row awarded on pickup while the replacement flag is on.

Fields.Name: Sliding Bullet Hit Type
Fields.Description: Whether ground-following bullets slide along the asset when they hit it. 0: only on static assets. 1: never. 2: always.

Fields.Name: Only Damaged by Bush Attacks
Fields.Description: Only special attacks can damage the asset (bushes): an attack must be flagged for it and have object attack power above Defence.

Fields.Name: Penetration Bullet Type
Fields.Description: Which bullet penetration flag decides whether a bullet passes through. 0: map's if static, object's if dynamic. 1: map's. 2: object's. 3: character's. 4: bullets always pass through. With 1, the bullet's no-hit-SFX-on-object flag is ignored.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing Culling Mode
Fields.Description: Culling mode used for the asset in ray tracing. Passed to the model setup.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing Effective Distance Override
Fields.Description: Distance (m) within which the asset is included in ray tracing. 0 or less: no override.

Fields.Name: Break Sound Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly where the break sound plays; it plays at every dummy poly with this ID. -1: at the asset's position.

Fields.Name: Debug - Height Check Minimum
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (a map tool check of the asset's ground height).

Fields.Name: Debug - Height Check Maximum
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (a map tool check of the asset's ground height).

Fields.Name: Repick - Action Button ID
Fields.Description: ActionButtonParam row used when repicking.

Fields.Name: Repick - Item Lot Param ID
Fields.Description: ItemLotParam_map row awarded when repicking.

Fields.Name: Repick Replacement - Anim ID Offset
Fields.Description: When repicking with the replacement flag on, the uncollected and collected animations are offset by this value (collected = offset + 1).

Fields.Name: Repick Replacement - Action Button Param ID
Fields.Description: ActionButtonParam row used when repicking with the replacement flag on.

Fields.Name: Repick Replacement - Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: ItemLotParam_map row awarded when repicking with the replacement flag on.

Fields.Name: Is Hit Carver Generation Blocked
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (navmesh build setting).

Fields.Name: No Giant Collision After Break
Fields.Description: After breaking, the asset uses a collision filter that giant enemies don't collide with.

Fields.Name: Is Destruction Synchronized
Fields.Description: Synchronises the asset in multiplayer (initial state, map activation and destruction). Off: not synchronised, and remote players' attacks don't hit it.

Fields.Name: Is Hidden on Repick
Fields.Description: When repicking, the asset is hidden if its item lot can't be obtained.

Fields.Name: Is Valid for Multiplayer Only
Fields.Description: The asset only exists in multiplayer. Dynamic assets only.

Fields.Name: Is Bullet Hit SFX Disabled
Fields.Description: Bullets that hit the asset play no hit effect, whether they pass through or land.

Fields.Name: Is Bloodstain/Sign Enabled before Destruction
Fields.Description: Summon signs and bloodstains can be placed on the asset before it breaks.

Fields.Name: Is Bloodstain/Sign Enabled after Destruction
Fields.Description: Summon signs and bloodstains can be placed on the asset after it breaks.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing Target Type
Fields.Description: Whether the asset is included in ray tracing. 0: automatic (by Behavior Type). 1 and 2: explicit types. 3: excluded.

Fields.Name: Multiplayer Forbidden Region Type
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (summon and invasion forbidden region generation, likely a map tool setting).

Fields.Name: Resident SE ID [0]
Fields.Description: Looping sound 0 attached to the asset. ≤ 0: none.

Fields.Name: Resident SE ID [1]
Fields.Description: Looping sound 1 attached to the asset. ≤ 0: none.

Fields.Name: Resident SE ID [2]
Fields.Description: Looping sound 2 attached to the asset. ≤ 0: none.

Fields.Name: Resident SE ID [3]
Fields.Description: Looping sound 3 attached to the asset. ≤ 0: none.

Fields.Name: Resident SE ID - Dummy Poly [0]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly looping sound 0 is attached to. -1: the asset's position.

Fields.Name: Resident SE ID - Dummy Poly [1]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly looping sound 1 is attached to. -1: the asset's position.

Fields.Name: Resident SE ID - Dummy Poly [2]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly looping sound 2 is attached to. -1: the asset's position.

Fields.Name: Resident SE ID - Dummy Poly [3]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly looping sound 3 is attached to. -1: the asset's position.

Fields.Name: Exclude Activate Ratio - Xbox One Grid
Fields.Description: Xbox One only (open-world blocks): rate of these assets left out to save resources. Not used on PC. A value set on the MSB part overrides it.

Fields.Name: Exclude Activate Ratio - Xbox One Legacy
Fields.Description: Xbox One only (legacy dungeons): rate of these assets left out to save resources. Not used on PC. A value set on the MSB part overrides it.

Fields.Name: Exclude Activate Ratio - PS4 Grid
Fields.Description: PS4 only (open-world blocks): rate of these assets left out to save resources. Not used on PC. A value set on the MSB part overrides it.

Fields.Name: Exclude Activate Ratio - PS4 Legacy
Fields.Description: PS4 only (legacy dungeons): rate of these assets left out to save resources. Not used on PC. A value set on the MSB part overrides it.

Fields.Name: Automatic Destruction Distance
Fields.Description: The asset plays its break animation when the player comes within this distance (m). ≤ 0: off. Needs Is Animated Destruction.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing BLAS Rebuild Settings (Before Destruction)
Fields.Description: Ray tracing BLAS rebuild setting before the asset breaks. 0: automatic.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing BLAS Rebuild Settings (After Destruction)
Fields.Description: Ray tracing BLAS rebuild setting after the asset breaks. 0: automatic.

Fields.Name: LOD Parameter ID in Normal Mode
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.
Padding.
